svt_mipi_dsi_device Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_device:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This class implements MIPI DSI Device Driver components. This driver performs checks on received packets from Host and formed the packet. If host needs response then it transmits response to Host driver. It also injects error into response packet using exception.

 svt_mipi_dsi_device::post_lane_transaction_get
 (  int lane_id , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact , ref bit drop  ) 

Callback issued by driver after pulling a transaction descriptor out of its input port, but before acting on the transaction descriptor in any way.

lane_id - Numerical ID that identifies which input port was just accessed.

drop - A ref argument, which if sets by the user's callback implementation causes the driver to discard the transaction descriptor without further action.
